items.prompt: Popped (left,H) at exclusive i has width what?

options.why: The right boundary i is exclusive, so [left,i) contains exactly i-left bars.
Adding one would include the current bar, which triggered the pop and is not part of the popped span.
The width is nonnegative; reversing the subtraction gives the wrong sign.
H is a height, not a horizontal boundary, so subtracting left from it is not a width.
